**Inspecting tags in payload**

I’m looking into the memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload calls, specifically how it assigns the Tags and Property. It seems ExtractAll includes Mentions, but I’m not entirely sure if the payload references this correctly. I need to inspect the complete ExtractAll function and also check its call sites related to RebuildMemoPayload. A bit of searching will help clarify this! It's essential to understand the relationship between these properties fully.

args.command: shopt -s globstar nullglob; awk '/func \(s \*service\) ExtractAll/ { print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" $0 }' internal/markdown/*.go
shopt -s globstar nullglob; awk '/RebuildMemoPayload\(/ { print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" $0 }' **/*.go
